{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_15/silicon_melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (Angstrom, ps, eV, K, bar)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber for Si
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Initial velocity at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 482756 dist gaussian

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 fs
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000

# Unfix heating
unfix           1

# Equilibration phase at 2500K for 500 ps
# Output MSD data every 100 steps
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             3 all vector 100 c_msd[4]
run             500000

# Write MSD data
variable        msd_time equal step*dt-1000.0
variable        msd_value equal c_msd[4]
fix             4 all print 100 "${msd_time} ${msd_value}" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# time(ps) msd(A^2)"

# Continue for data collection
run             0

# Clean up
unfix           2
unfix           3
unfix           4

print "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

{"content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
time = data[:, 0]  # time in ps
msd = data[:, 1]   # MSD in A^2

# Skip initial transient (first 50 ps) and use linear region
# For liquid silicon at 2500K, we expect good linear behavior after equilibration
start_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(time - 50))  # Start from 50 ps
end_idx = len(time)

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t (for 3D diffusion)
# D = slope / 6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # A^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # A^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 A = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 A^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} A^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6e} A^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"Final answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, coeffs[0]*time_fit + coeffs[1], 'r--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f} A²/ps)')
plt.axvline(x=50, color='g', linestyle=':', label='Fit start')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and computing diffusion coefficient
# Units: metal (mass=grams/mole, distance=Angstroms, time=picoseconds, energy=eV, temperature=K, pressure=bars)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber for Silicon
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Define neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute temperature and pressure
compute         mytemp all temp
compute         mypress all pressure mytemp

# Set timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate self-diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]  # MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert step to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = steps * timestep  # time in ps

# Skip initial transient and use linear regime for fitting
# Use data from 20% to 80% of the production run
n_points = len(time)
start_idx = int(0.2 * n_points)
end_idx = int(0.8 * n_points)

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# Slope = 6*D in Angstrom^2/ps
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit results:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {coeffs[1]:.6e} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Calculate R^2 to check quality of fit
msd_fit_predicted = np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit)
ss_res = np.sum((msd_fit - msd_fit_predicted)**2)
ss_tot = np.sum((msd_fit - np.mean(msd_fit))**2)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
print(f"  R^2 = {r_squared:.6f}")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=====================================================\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"\nFit quality: R^2 = {r_squared:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Time range used: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, msd_fit_predicted, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_squared:.4f})\nD={D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time\nLiquid Silicon at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=300)
print(f"\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Print final result in requested format
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {D_m2_s:.6e}")
print(f"{'='*60}")

print("Data inspection:")
print(f"Time range: {time_ps[0]:.2f} to {time_ps[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_raw[0]:.2f} to {msd_raw[-1]:.2f} A^2")
print(f"Total data points: {len(time_ps)}")

# Subtract initial MSD value to get change in MSD
msd = msd_raw - msd_raw[0]

print(f"\nCorrected MSD range: {msd[0]:.2f} to {msd[-1]:.2f} A^2")

# Use data from 10 ps onwards for fitting (avoid initial transient)
start_time_ps = 10.0
start_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(time_ps - start_time_ps))

time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

print(f"\nFitting from {time_fit[0]:.2f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Number of points in fit: {len(time_fit)}")

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # A^2/ps
intercept = coeffs[1]

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} A^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} A^2")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# MSD = 6*D*t => D = slope/6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # A^2/ps
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8  # m^2/s

plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.plot(time_fit, msd_fit, 'go', markersize=2, alpha=0.3, label='Data')

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_31/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the equilibration data
data = pd.read_csv('equilibration_data.csv')

# Extract step and MSD
steps = data['Step'].values
msd = data['c_msd[4]'].values

# Convert steps to time (ps) - timestep is 0.001 ps
# Time relative to start of equilibration (step 1e6)
time = (steps - steps[0]) * 0.001  # in ps

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'o-', label='MSD data')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('msd_vs_time.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# Use linear regression on the linear regime to get the slope
# Skip the first few points to avoid initial transient behavior
# Use data from 50 ps onwards for better linear regime
start_idx = np.where(time >= 50)[0][0] if len(time[time >= 50]) > 0 else len(time)//4

if start_idx < len(time) - 10:
    time_fit = time[start_idx:]
    msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]
    
    # Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t + intercept
    coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
    slope = coeffs[0]  # This is 6*D in Angstrom^2/ps
    
    # Calculate diffusion coefficient
    D_angstrom2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps
    
    # Convert to m^2/s
    # 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
    # 1 ps = 1e-12 s
    # So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
    D_m2_s = D_angstrom2_ps * 1e-8
    
    print(f"Linear fit from {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")
    print(f"Slope (6D): {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
    print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
    print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
    
    # Plot with fit
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.plot(time, msd, 'o', label='MSD data', markersize=4)
    plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r-', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (D={D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
    plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
    plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
    plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.legend()
    plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()
    
    # Save result
    with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(f"{D_m2_s:.6e}\n")
    
else:
    print("Not enough data points for reliable fitting")
    print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
    print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.1f} to {time[-1]:.1f} ps")
"}

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       si.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set neighbor list
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute initial temperature
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# Stage 1: Heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 fs
# Use smaller timestep: 0.5 fs
timestep        0.5

fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             2000000
unfix           1

# Stage 2: Equilibrate at 2500K for 500 ps under NPT
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           2

# Stage 3: Production run to compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
# Reset time and compute MSD
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
thermo          1000
run             1000000

unfix           3
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and calculating diffusion coefficient

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set neighbor list
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps = 0.0022 K/fs
# Temperature change: 2500 - 300 = 2200 K
# Time required: 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 fs
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ============================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000
unfix           3

# ============================================
# Stage 4: Production run with MSD calculation
# ============================================
# Reset timestep counter

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the equilibration data
data = pd.read_csv('equilibration_data.csv')

# Extract step and MSD
steps = data['Step'].values
msd = data['c_msd[4]'].values

# Convert steps to time (ps) - timestep is 0.001 ps
# Time relative to start of equilibration (step 1e6)
time = (steps - steps[0]) * 0.001  # in ps

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'o-', label='MSD data')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('msd_vs_time.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# Use linear regression on the linear regime to get the slope
# Skip the first few points to avoid initial transient behavior
# Use data from 50 ps onwards for better linear regime
start_idx = np.where(time >= 50)[0][0] if len(time[time >= 50]) > 0 else len(time)//4

if start_idx < len(time) - 10:
    time_fit = time[start_idx:]
    msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]
    
    # Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t + intercept
    coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
    slope = coeffs[0]  # This is 6*D in Angstrom^2/ps
    
    # Calculate diffusion coefficient
    D_angstrom2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps
    
    # Convert to m^2/s
    # 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
    # 1 ps = 1e-12 s
    # So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
    D_m2_s = D_angstrom2_ps * 1e-8
    
    print(f"Linear fit from {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")
    print(f"Slope (6D): {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
    print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
    print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
    
    # Plot with fit
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.plot(time, msd, 'o', label='MSD data', markersize=4)
    plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r-', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit (D={D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
    plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
    plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
    plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.legend()
    plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()
    
    # Save result
    with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(f"{D_m2_s:.6e}\n")
    
else:
    print("Not enough data points for reliable fitting")
    print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
    print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.1f} to {time[-1]:.1f} ps")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_39/msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.0005 ps, output every 100 steps

output_freq = 100
time = steps * dt * output_freq  # ps

# Use the Einstein relation: D = MSD / (6t)
# We'll use a linear fit to the later part of the MSD vs time curve
# to get a more accurate slope

# Use the second half of the data for fitting (equilibrated region)
start_idx = len(time) // 2
time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6Dt + constant
# Slope = 6D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Å²/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D = slope / 6.0  # Å²/ps

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 10^-10 m
# 1 ps = 10^-12 s
# Å²/ps = 10^-20 m² / 10^-12 s = 10^-8 m²/s

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_52/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Column 4 is MSD_total

# Convert steps to time (dt = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = steps * 0.001  # in picoseconds

# Fit the linear region of MSD vs time to get diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6, where slope is from MSD = 6*D*t
# We'll use the last 70% of the data for fitting (more equilibrated)
fit_start = int(len(time_ps) * 0.3)
time_fit = time_ps[fit_start:]
msd_fit = msd_total[fit_start:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom2_per_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_per_s = D_angstrom2_per_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer (in scientific notation): {D_m2_per_s:.2e}")

# Plot MSD vs time with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (last 70%)\nD = {D_m2_per_s:.2e} m²/s', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_per_s:.2e}\n")
print("Result saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (eV, Angstrom, ps, K)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration at 300K
unfix           1

# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # Heat for 1000 ps
unfix           2

# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             50000  # 50 ps initial equilibration
unfix           3

# Stage 4: Production run at 2500K for 500 ps with MSD calculation
# Reset MSD compute
uncompute       msd
compute         msd all msd com yes

fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Output MSD data more frequently for better statistics
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[1] c_msd[2] c_msd[3] c_msd[4]

dump            1 all custom 1000 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z vx vy vz
dump_modify     1 sort id

run             500000  # 500 ps production run

# Write final configuration
write_data      final.data

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

"""
Analyze MSD data to calculate the self-diffusion coefficient using the Einstein relation.
D = lim(t→∞) MSD/(6t)
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]  # in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # ps

# Skip the initial transient and use the linear regime
# We'll use the second half of the data for fitting
n_points = len(time)
start_idx = n_points // 2

time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# Perform linear regression: MSD = 6D*t + b
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# slope = 6D, so D = slope/6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D[m^2/s] = D[A^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12) = D[A^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print("=" * 60)
print("Diffusion Coefficient Analysis")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Data points used for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")
print(f"Time range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Linear fit: MSD = {slope:.6f} * t + {intercept:.6f}")
print(f"R-squared: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6e}")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print("=" * 60)

# Save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (Angstrom^2/ps): {D_A2_ps:.6e}\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (m^2/s): {D_m2_s:.6e}\n")
    f.write(f"R-squared: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")

# Create a plot
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

# Plot 1: Full MSD vs time
ax1.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
ax1.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R² = {r_value**2:.4f})')
ax1.set_xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Fitted region only
ax2.plot(time_fit, msd_fit, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data (fit region)')
ax2.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit: slope = {slope:.4f}')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Linear Regime for Diffusion Calculation', fontsize=14)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

print(f"\nPlot saved as 'msd_analysis.png'")

# Print the final answer in scientific notation
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = steps * 0.001

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We'll fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data)
skip = len(time_ps) // 10
time_fit = time_ps[skip:]
msd_fit = msd_total[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D in Angstrom^2/ps
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / 1e-12 m^2/s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"MSD data points: {len(steps)}")
print(f"Time range: {time_ps[0]:.2f} to {time_ps[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} to {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nLinear fit (using last 90% of data):")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.4f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement at 2500K\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=" * 50 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
df = pd.read_csv('msd_data.csv')

print(f"Total data points: {len(df)}")
print(f"Time range: {df['Step'].min()} to {df['Step'].max()} steps")

# In LAMMPS metal units:
# - time is in picoseconds (ps)
# - MSD is in Angstrom^2
# timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs

timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = df['Step'].values * timestep  # Convert steps to time in ps

# MSD[4] is the total MSD (sum of x, y, z components)
msd = df['c_msd[4]'].values  # in Angstrom^2

# Skip initial transient - use data from 50 ps onwards for fitting
skip_time = 50  # ps
mask = time >= skip_time
time_fit = time[mask]
msd_fit = msd[mask]

print(f"\nUsing data from {time_fit[0]} ps to {time_fit[-1]} ps for fitting")
print(f"Number of points for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# Fit linear regression to get slope
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

print(f"\nSlope from linear fit: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_angstrom2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m

D_m2_s = D_angstrom2_ps * 1e-8

    f.write(f"Slope (MSD vs time): {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal, Temperature in K, pressure in bars, time in ps

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set mass for Silicon
mass            1 28.0855

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# ========================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K
# ========================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000
unfix           1

# ========================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps
# ========================================
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000
unfix           2

# ========================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ========================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000
unfix           3

# ========================================
# Stage 4: Production run with MSD calculation
# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
# ========================================
# Reset timestep counter for cleaner MSD analysis
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# step msd_x msd_y msd_z msd_total"

thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd[4]

run             500000

unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

# Write final configuration
write_data      final_structure.data

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
df = pd.read_csv('msd_data.csv')

print(f"Total data points: {len(df)}")
print(f"Time range: {df['Step'].min()} to {df['Step'].max()} steps")

# In LAMMPS metal units:
# - time is in picoseconds (ps)
# - MSD is in Angstrom^2
# timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs

timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = df['Step'].values * timestep  # Convert steps to time in ps

# MSD[4] is the total MSD (sum of x, y, z components)
msd = df['c_msd[4]'].values  # in Angstrom^2

# Skip initial transient - use data from 50 ps onwards for fitting
skip_time = 50  # ps
mask = time >= skip_time
time_fit = time[mask]
msd_fit = msd[mask]

print(f"\nUsing data from {time_fit[0]} ps to {time_fit[-1]} ps for fitting")
print(f"Number of points for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# Fit linear regression to get slope
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

print(f"\nSlope from linear fit: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_angstrom2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12)
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-20 / 1e-12
# D [m^2/s] = D [Angstrom^2/ps] * 1e-8

D_m2_s = D_angstrom2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (Angstrom^2/ps): {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e}\n")
    f.write(f"Slope (MSD vs time): {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f})', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom^2)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Si at 2500K')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL RESULT: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"{'='*60}")
